Done. The name lookups now live in the store, and the template reads them through two pure pipes.

- **Store:** `src/app/features/deals/data/deals.store.ts` already had private  and  helpers. I made them public and removed the page's duplicate methods.
- **Pipes:** generated with `ng g pipe`, then implemented. `src/app/features/deals/ui/pipes/account-name-pipe.ts` and `src/app/features/deals/ui/pipes/contact-name-pipe.ts` inject  and delegate to the store. Pipe names are  and .
- **Page:** `src/app/features/deals/pages/deals-list/deals-list.page.ts` imports both pipes and uses `deal.accountId | accountName` and `deal.contactId | contactName` in its three bindings.

Type-check and lint pass. I also removed an unused `Injectable` import from the store, which lint flagged.

A pure pipe only re-runs when its input id changes. If account or contact names later become editable, the pipes will not refresh on their own, and you would need an impure pipe or a different approach.
